entries.description: A character from the art of naruto2413's track 'AI Bomb (On Vocal)', a vocal cover of his chiptune classic. From the artist: When I showed this character to the vocalist Aya Majiro, she said "I want to use this avatar too.". We named the character "Ushi-chan" (Ushi is cow in Japanese, and her horns resemble those of a cow).

entries.description: 'I just want to make music with friends...' Meet Shirobeats! An electronic producer with a whole crew of vocalists, known for their variety of collabs. Try their tracks "In Time" and "Show Off" in RoBeats!
entries.name: Shirobeats

entries.description: From the artist: Galaxy Collapse's sequel? Original song is Emotional Skyscraper ~ Cosmic Mind from Touhou 12. Permission granted by Team Shanghai Alice. Map by Fritzy.
entries.name: Scattered Faith (Easy)

entries.description: Santa's elves are often said to make toys in Santa's workshop, to be delivered to good boys and girls on Christmas day. Track 2 from F-777's album 'It's Freaking Christmas'. Art by NickTSO. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Toy Factory (Easy)

entries.description: Track 12 from Camellia and Nanahira's album 'Go-In', premiering at Comiket 96 in 2019. Nanahira is an independent VTuber and game streamer. Map by iijohn0 and Stepongzi.
entries.name: I don't care about Christmas though  (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: Hi! It's Camellia. When I asked you for a request of genre of music for 70k on Twitter, I received a lot of replies and genres. This 'Nacreous Snowmelt' once came up with them, all kinds of genres. Map by Himitsu.
entries.name: Nacreous Snowmelt (Easy)

entries.description: A 2020 track by Japanese producer brz1128, an entry in the SSTA2020 (Shooter's Stadium 2020) K-ShootMANIA music competition. Art by by4co.
entries.name: Canneles au chocolat (Easy)

entries.description: Liquate: To separate or purify (a metal) by melting it. Track 9 from Camellia's 2015 album 'crystallized'. Art by dhanfrhr. Map by Ucitysm and VIVIDDEBUT.
entries.name: liquated (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: Thank you so much 'Robeats' for giving me the support you do. This was a great track to make and I did my utmost effort to do the most in this track. That's what Christmas is all about: the joy of others and the ability to cherish what you have! Map by Himitsu.
entries.name: Comfort Zone (Easy)

entries.description: A 2015 Happy Hardcore track by Japanese producer brz1128. Art by Kanna_Chann.
entries.name: Twinkle*Winter (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: my favorite of the whole thing. Track 3 from producer dark cat's 2016 album 'finite EP'. Map by AmyKawashima.
entries.name: BANANA STREET (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: i hope you enjoyed this track as much as I did making it - and I hope you're having a christmas! Art by Pumpkwi. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: HOT CHOCOLATE (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: Well, it was really fun making this song to celebrate Christmas, and in this song, I tried to pass on the feeling of snow and Christmas. It's my first time making music for Robeats and I hope everyone enjoys it!
entries.name: Crystallized Snow (Easy)

entries.description: A 2014 track by Latvian producer Tobu. From the artist: 20,000,000... omg, thanks guys!! Music: Tobu - Colors (youtube.com/tobuofficial) Released by NCS (youtube.com/NoCopyrightSounds). Art by SKL.PROD. Map by Ucitysm.
entries.name: Colors (Easy)

entries.description: A 2021 track by producer and artist atsuover. From the artist: I finally worked up the confidence to do this. It's not that great, but hey: that's what the song's about. Map by fritzy.
entries.name: GOOD ENOUGH! (Full Vocal Version) (Easy)

entries.description: The first track from FNF Smoke 'Em Out Struggle - an original full week mod by atsuover and rageminer. Face off against a man named GARCELLO, as he tries to peer pressure Boyfriend into smoking a strange cigarette. Map by Himitsu.
entries.name: HEADACHE (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: Here's my Christmas gift to you guys for Christmas :]. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Christmas Frenzy (Easy)

entries.description: Discover the dark side of the werewolf named Lycurgus and go wild together in the forest.. Enjoy this Artcore, Dubstep and UK Hardcore mixed genre song created by Ardolf. Map by Ucitysm.
entries.name: Varcolac (Easy)

entries.description: A 2014 track by producers Tobu and Itro. Music: Tobu & Itro - Sunburst (youtube.com/tobuofficial) (youtube.com/user/officialitro) Released by NCS (youtube.com/NoCopyrightSounds). Map by Ucitysm.
entries.name: Sunburst (Easy)

entries.description: A 2021 collaboration between producers Jim Yosef, Electro-Light, Anna Yvette, Deaf Kev and Tobu. From Tobu: did you expect this? Music: Tobu, Jim Yosef, Electro-Light, Anna Yvette & Deaf Kev - Destiny (youtube.com/tobuofficial). Art by ST4RLYTE. Map by Himitsu.
entries.artist: Jim Yosef, Electro-Light, Anna Yvette, Deaf Kev & Tobu
entries.name: Destiny (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: Crazy how it's been 5 years already..  An idea just popped in my head I should make 2018/2019 version of this song. Who'd love that? Music: Tobu - Higher (youtube.com/tobuofficial). Map by fritzy.
entries.name: Higher (Easy)

entries.description: The second track from FNF Smoke 'Em Out Struggle - an original full week mod by atsuover and rageminer. From the FNF wiki: When Garcello died, his soul was bound to the cigarette. Map by AmyKawashima.
entries.name: NERVES (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: let's get funky now - it's a lovers' oasis. #catstep. Map by iijohn0.
entries.name: LOVERS' OASIS (Easy)

entries.description: A 2020 track by Japanese artist and music producer Se-U-Ra. From the artist: I give you a new song: 'Se-U-Ra Chronoto'. I'll still wait!
entries.name: Chronoto (Easy)

entries.description: Featured in Just Dance 2018, this was the first song by 'The Just Dance Band' in the series. Composed by Tom Salta. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by AmyKawashima.
entries.name: All You Gotta Do (Is Just Dance) (Easy)

entries.description: First featured in Just Dance 2016, this is the first song by Wanko Ni Mero Mero in the series. Composed by Tom Salta, and performed by Japanese singer ReniReni. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Chiwawa (Easy)

entries.description: First featured in Just Dance 2016. An instrumental track heavily influenced by traditional Irish music, in-game it is performed as a quartet dance. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Irish Meadow Dance (Easy)

entries.description: A funk track inspired by martial arts movies of the 70's and 80's, first featured in Just Dance 2016. Throw some Karate moves while dancing along to this! Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Kool Kontact (Easy)

entries.description: Track 10 from producer F-777's 2013 album of the same name. From the artist: Here is my first album of the year 2013 and its MASSIVE! I had so much fun making this and I hope you enjoy these songs. Map by Fritzy.
entries.name: Deadlocked (Easy)

entries.description: Track 8 from producer F-777's 2015 album of the same name. From the artist: So for years now people have been asking me to make more songs like 'Ludicrous Speed'. So I decided instead to make an entire album featuring some fast tracks! Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Ludicrous Speed (Easy)

entries.description: Track 5 from producer F-777's 2016 album of the same name. From the artist: I love you guys so much. Stay awesome and BLAST DEM SPEAKERS!! Map by DeadpanSky21.
entries.name: Monster Dance Off (Easy)

entries.description: Track 2 from producer F-777's 2015 album 'Celtic Dance Machine'. From the artist: I had an AMAZING fun time making this! I have always been in love with traditional Celtic music and even more modern styles such as found in the performance 'Lord of The Dance'. Map by Himitsu.
entries.name: Dance of The Violins (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: yay! thanks to @j1n7n for singing on my track & writing the lyrics, and thanks to @cindersedm for working on this! Art by LackleTackle. Map by Himitsu.
entries.name: BUBBLE TEA (Easy)

entries.description: An electronic track inspired by Japanese Mecha animes of the 80's and 90's. First featured in Just Dance 2014. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by fritzy.
entries.name: Nitro Bot (Easy)

entries.description: Featured in Just Dance 3, this was the first Japanese song to be added to the Just Dance series. Inspired by the Japanese series 'Super Sentai', known in America as 'Power Rangers'. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by AmyKawashima.
entries.name: Spectronizer (Easy)

entries.description: A track used for 'Just Sweat', an exercise mode in Just Dance 4. A retro-style workout with kitschy 60's flair! The track's original name was Piccadilly Circus. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by AmyKawashima.
entries.name: Swinging 60's Workout (Intense Mix) (Easy)

entries.description: Welcome to RoBeats! Want to learn how to play? We're here to show you!
entries.name: Monday Night Monsters (Tutorial)

entries.description: A track in the style of 'Oshare Kei', a Japanese music and fashion movement known for bright, cheerful colors, lots of jewlery and positive and upbeat music. First featured in Just Dance 2018. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by fritzy.
entries.name: Sayonara (Easy)

entries.description: Featured in Just Dance 2021, this is Arabic-language track includes vocals from Steve Ouimette and Kurupt Tha Killa. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: Yameen Yasar (Easy)

entries.description: A track used for 'Just Sweat', an exercise mode in Just Dance 4. You can select this track as a 10, 25 or 45 minute workout. Muy Bien! Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by AmyKawashima.
entries.name: Sweat Around The World (Intense Mix) (Easy)

entries.description: A Bollywood-themed XMas song first featured in Just Dance 2015. A portmanteau of 'Bombay' and 'Hollywood', Bollywood is a style of Indian Hindi-language film that often includes song and dance. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by doofyplayer.
entries.name: XMas Tree (Easy)

entries.description: Featured in Just Dance 2018, this was the second song in the series by 'The Just Dance Band'. Hosted from a 2021 promotional event for Just Dance 2021, with all rights reserved to Ubisoft. Map by fritzy.
entries.name: Sugar Dance (Easy)

entries.description: The first track of the album 'Ludicrous Speed' by Jesse Valentine, also known as F-777.
entries.name: Space Battle (Easy)

entries.description: The third track from FNF Smoke 'Em Out Struggle - an original full week mod by atsuover and rageminer. Tight bars, little man... Map by Himitsu.
entries.name: RELEASE (Easy)

entries.description: From the artist: Brightest star is a movement of energy that keeps the star shining. But you, as one, need to shine the brightest you can be. Map by fritzy.
entries.name: Brightest Star (Easy)

entries.description: Genshindou was the hardest track we've worked on in a long time and our first time doing an anime song! This was used as the official ED theme for @dillongoo's Progenitor animation series in Genshin Impact's HoYoFair. Map by Fritzy.
entries.artist: Autodidactic Studios feat. Waterflame, Diana Garnet, and pftq
entries.name: Genshindou (Easy)

entries.description: A 2020 track from brz1128's first album 'Prism'. Art by 4ra8_. Featured in SFES2019, an online music creation competition for music game k-shoot mania (KSM). Map by fritzy.
entries.name: strawberry sherbet(KSMEdit) (Easy)

entries.description: Known as 'Mousou Chu!!' in Japanese. Track 2 from Ponchi's 1st album 'Kokoro Diary', featuring vocals by haxchi. Art by Ameno Usari. Ponchi is one half of the duo MisoilePunch. Map by fritzy.
entries.name: Delusional!! (Easy)

entries.description: A 2020 track by Latvian producer Tobu and Swedish producer Mangoo. Art by iroarts. Third time is the charm! Map by Ucitysm.
entries.name: Who Needs A Broken Heart (Easy)

entries.description: A crimson color fills my eyes / A sweet fantasy stirs my heart / A world of intense brilliance, yearned for, dyes my fleeting dreams. Track 5 from 2020 album 'Celestial Sight'.
entries.name: Crimsonate (Easy)

entries.description: Are you ready to travel to space with me? Art by Tempest. Map by Pyrromxniac.
entries.name: Rotanautica (Easy)

entries.description: Five songs that open up a new world view of the BlackY Sound - Track 3 from BlackY's 2023 solo album 'ATARAXIA EP'. Map by Pyrromxniac.
entries.name: Destination (Easy)

entries.description: ducc returns - Just warming up :D. Map by Pyrromxniac.
entries.name: Full Restore (Easy)
